answers.core: It involves core functionality around loading assets.
answers.workaround:
This would be used frequently by many Godot users I suspect, as many level-based games want to maintain references to each other. 

Currently I’m keeping a string as a path to the next room, but this is fallable, as a room could be renamed or moved. Another more robust solution can be seen [here](https://x.com/the_duriel/status/1726608201309896962), but this is a bit ugly and not very convenient.
